CustomField.description: Which of the two guest-writable draft populations this row belongs to. The two rows are otherwise implicitly distinguishable (a Booking row always has Draft_Key__c + Saved_Configuration__c; an Assessment row always has Resume_Token__c) but an implicit discriminator is exactly what breaks under a later refactor -- and here the failure mode is one guest population reading the other's answers. Both GtmFormDraftController and GtmAssessmentDraftController add "AND Draft_Type__c = '...'" to every WHERE clause and set it on every insert. Defaults to Booking so GtmFormDraftController's existing inserts (which never set this field) keep working untouched.
CustomField.label: Draft Type
